paper_title: UPconversion Loop Oscillator Axion Detection experiment: A precision frequency interferometric axion dark matter search with a Cylindrical Microwave Cavity
notes: Erratum-corrected results of UPLOAD-CMC (Thomson et al., arXiv:1912.07751v5). Room-temperature dual-mode cavity haloscope using frequency metrology. Corrected measured 95% CL exclusion: upconversion range 7.44-19.38 neV excludes g_agamma > 3e-3 GeV^-1; downconversion range 74.4-74.5 ueV excludes g_agamma > 1e-2 GeV^-1. These are the minimal excluded coupling values quoted in text (actual limit curve varies with Fourier frequency, exact plot digitization not possible). Assumes rho_DM = 0.45 GeV/cm^3 with Maxwell-Boltzmann halo (vc = 225 km/s).
